operations.summary: Page through jobs in the authenticated tenant scope
operations.description: Requires a tenant-scoped identity with jobs.read. Scope is derived only from the authenticated identity. Supplying tenant_id is an attempted scope override and returns 403.

params.name: from
params.description: Inclusive RFC3339 creation-time bound.

params.name: to
params.description: Exclusive RFC3339 creation-time bound; from-to may not exceed 31 days.

params.name: status
params.type: array<string: queued / running / succeeded / partial_failed / failed / cancelled>
params.description: Comma-separated job states; duplicates are rejected.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Exact task UUID filter.

params.name: resource
params.description: Exact match against the canonical job subject/reference, or a case-insensitive match against a node UUID assigned to one of the job's items, so node pages can deep-link to the tasks executed on that node.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque, authenticated, versioned HMAC-SHA256 keyset cursor from the preceding response, bound to route scope, endpoint, task, and filters. Reuse with changed inputs or any token modification returns 400.

params.name: page
params.description: Explicit canonical positive decimal page number, mutually exclusive with cursor even if cursor is empty. Count and rows use one read-only repeatable-read snapshot. Different requests are live snapshots and may move rows as jobs are inserted or change state. A page beyond the end returns an empty data array, the requested number and the exact total.

responses.description: Authenticated keyset page or explicit numbered page with a same-snapshot exact total.

fields.name: task_metadata
fields.description: Present only in explicit numbered-page mode, including an empty array for an empty page.

responses.description: job_invalid_request: invalid UUID, query input, Idempotency-Key, content type, or exact empty JSON command body.
job_authentication_required: authentication is missing or invalid.
job_permission_denied or job_scope_forbidden: permission is missing, audience is incompatible, or the caller attempted a scope override.
job_request_cancelled: the inbound request context was cancelled.
job_store_invalid_response or job_response_too_large: stored facts were invalid or the bounded response was too large.
job_store_unavailable: PostgreSQL or the configured Reader is unavailable.
job_query_timeout: the bounded request timed out.

operations.summary: Cancel a queued or running job in the authenticated tenant
operations.description: Requires jobs.manage. Scope is derived only from the authenticated identity. The transition, audit, and receipt commit atomically. The same actor and Idempotency-Key return the immutable first successful snapshot with replayed=true; reuse for another command returns 409.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Canonical lower-case UUID of the background job.

params.name: If-Match
params.description: Strong ETag value returned by the latest job detail or command response.

responses.description: Immutable cancelled or queued command result snapshot.

fields.name: replayed
fields.description: True when this response came from the durable command receipt.

responses.description: job_invalid_request: invalid UUID, query input, Idempotency-Key, content type, or exact empty JSON command body.
job_authentication_required: authentication is missing or invalid.
job_permission_denied or job_scope_forbidden: permission is missing, audience is incompatible, or the caller attempted a scope override.
job_not_found: the task does not exist or is outside the authenticated tenant scope.
job_request_cancelled: the inbound request context was cancelled.

job_idempotency_conflict, job_invalid_transition, job_retries_exhausted, or job_producer_command_required: the key was reused for another command, the job changed or is ineligible, no retry attempt remains, or the job's producer owns the command. cache.operation cancel/retry is executed by the cache module (same audit and receipt as the cache operation API); job_producer_command_required is returned only for its replay, or when cache control is not enabled.
job_revision_conflict: the If-Match revision is stale; refresh the job before retrying.
job_store_invalid_response or job_response_too_large: stored facts were invalid or the bounded response was too large.
job_store_unavailable: PostgreSQL or the configured Reader is unavailable.
job_query_timeout: the bounded request timed out.
